nodes.summary: For the densities `N(c t + m, v)` with respect to Lebesgue measure, with known variance `v > 0` not depending on the parameter and arbitrary real slope `c` and offset `m`, the Fisher information of one observation is `I(θ) = c² / v` at every `θ`; it vanishes when `c = 0`. It is the second moment of the score `c (X - (c θ + m)) / v` under `X ∼ N(c θ + m, v)` (`integral_score_sq`).
nodes.title: Fisher information of the affine Gaussian location family

nodes.summary: For a positive density family, `E_θ [score²] = I(θ)`: the Fisher information of `FisherInformation.fisherInformation` is the second moment of the score under `p θ ν`.
nodes.title: Fisher information is the second moment of the score

nodes.summary: A sequence `A i` converging in distribution, times a sequence `η i` converging in probability to `0`, converges in probability to `0` (a consequence of Slutsky's theorem).
nodes.title: Product of a distributionally convergent and a vanishing sequence

nodes.summary: For the densities `N(c t + m, v)` with respect to Lebesgue measure, with known variance `v > 0` not depending on the parameter and arbitrary real slope `c` and offset `m` (`c = 0` allowed), the score `∂_θ log p θ x` is `c (x - (c θ + m)) / v`.
nodes.title: Score of the affine Gaussian location family

nodes.summary: The score `∂_θ log p θ x` of a one-parameter family of densities `p`.
nodes.title: Score function

nodes.summary: For i.i.d. observations with law `p θ₀ ν`, a positive density family differentiable in `θ` at `θ₀`, a measurable score with mean zero and `∫ score² d(p θ₀ ν) < ∞`, the normalized score `n^{-1/2} ∑_{i<n} score p θ₀ (X i)` converges in distribution to `N(0, I(θ₀))`.
nodes.title: Central limit theorem for the score

nodes.summary: Asymptotic normality of consistent roots of the likelihood equation (Cramér's conditions). nodes.title: Asymptotic normality of consistent roots of the likelihood equation

nodes.summary: Asymptotic normality of a consistent root of an estimating equation (one-dimensional Z-estimator under Cramér-type conditions). Let `X 0, X 1, …` be i.i.d. with law `μX` and let `ψ θ x` satisfy, for every `x` and every `θ` in the ball of radius `δ > 0` about `θ₀`: `ψ · x` and `∂_θ ψ · x` are differentiable at `θ`, and `|∂²_θ ψ θ x| ≤ M x` with `M` integrable. nodes.title: Asymptotic normality of a consistent root of an estimating equation

nodes.summary: If the random variables `X i` on one probability space converge in distribution to the constant `c`, then they converge to `c` in probability.
nodes.title: Convergence in distribution to a constant implies convergence in probability

nodes.summary: If `|W i| ≤ V i` on events `G i` whose complements have probability tending to `0`, and `V i` tends to `0` in probability, then `W i` tends to `0` in probability.
nodes.title: Convergence to zero in probability by domination on likely events

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
